condition: LIVE open-web search via Google CSE
design: one run per claim at rounds=2; both conditions derived from the same run, so round-1 queries are identical by construction
accumulation: Collected incrementally over 2 run(s) against a 100 queries/day free tier. Claims are never re-run: query generation is stochastic, so replaying a finished claim would miss the cache and spend quota for no new data. Summary statistics cover all claims listed here.
not_measured: verdict accuracy — measured separately in results/verdict/live_evidence_verdict.py, which replays these recorded queries from cache at zero quota
